description: 深夜蓝深眠氛围套系，可拆洗内胆、耐压填充与耐磨面料，四季安睡宠物窝

styleLock.backgroundSystem: 深夜蓝夜空底 #16283F 用于首屏与分屏氛围屏，云白 #FFFFFF 与浅灰 #F2F3F5 面板用于信息图与细节屏
styleLock.lightingSystem: 暗屏用顶部柔和月光感顶光带轻微晕影，亮屏用明亮均匀左前主光棚光，全程软接触阴影
styleLock.surfaceSystem: 柔软水洗布与短绒面料质感为主，浅灰哑光摄影台面
styleLock.typography: modern geometric sans-serif，短标题配小号英文副题，正文极简
styleLock.iconSystem: 细线图标 #8FA8C0、01-06 编号圆片与圆形角标，标签统一圆角
styleLock.presentationRules: 窝体为稳定圆角矩形软体积，变体与场景保持一致英雄机位，材质真实柔软不塌陷
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent premium night-sleep pet-bedding ecommerce visual system across the whole set; fixed palette of deep navy night blue #16283F, clean white #FFFFFF, misty blue-grey #8FA8C0 and warm amber accent #F2C94C; cool tone; modern geometric sans-serif short headlines with small letter-spaced English sub-captions; thin-line icons, numbered circles and round chips in blue-grey #8FA8C0; dark screens use a soft moon-glow top light with gentle vignette, white screens use bright even studio light with a front-left key and soft contact shadows; bed shown as a stable rounded-rectangular soft volume with realistic washed-fabric texture and a stable hero angle; balanced airy compositions; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.

shots.intent: 首屏以深夜月色氛围一秒传达深度睡眠的核心利益，赢得点击

shots.lighting: 顶部柔和月光感顶光带轻微晕影，冷调 4800K，软接触阴影
shots.background: 深夜蓝星空渐变 #16283F，月亮圆盘与细碎星点
shots.textZone: 顶部 30% 居中白色大标题「{callout_1}」+ 暖黄药丸标签「{callout_2}」+ 雾蓝灰小号英文副题
shots.promptTemplate: {style_lock}. E-commerce detail-page opening hero of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. Photographed at a slightly low front 3/4 angle, full body of {product} filling 50-60% of the frame with a relaxed pet sleeping belly-up inside, grounded by a soft contact shadow. Cool moon-glow top light with gentle vignette falloff at 4800K, realistic soft washed-fabric texture. Deep navy night-sky background #16283F with a glowing moon disc and subtle star specks wrapping around the bed. Text zone: top 30% centered white headline 「{callout_1}」, one small amber pill tag #F2C94C reading 「{callout_2}」, and a letter-spaced light blue-grey #8FA8C0 English sub-caption. 2K detail-page quality. Negative: no real brand names, no readable logos, no watermark, no QR code, no extra text, no deformed pet anatomy or fused paws, no floating product without contact shadow, no garbled characters, no color palette changes.

shots.lighting: 整版均匀明亮高调光，插图底部软接触阴影
shots.textZone: 顶部居中大标题「{callout_1}」+ 灰色短副题；六枚圆片内短标签「{selling_point_1}」至「{selling_point_6}」
shots.promptTemplate: {style_lock}. E-commerce benefit infographic about the value of deep sleep for {product}. {product_identity_lock}. Straight-on flat graphic layout on clean white #FFFFFF: a top centered headline 「{callout_1}」 in charcoal #2D2D2D with a short grey sub-line, six numbered circles in blue-grey #8FA8C0 tagged 01-06 scattered in a loose ring, each holding a short two-line label 「{selling_point_1}」 「{selling_point_2}」 「{selling_point_3}」 「{selling_point_4}」 「{selling_point_5}」 「{selling_point_6}」; in the lower-right a large inset photo of {product} with a relaxed sleeping pet, photographed from a high 45-degree angle, the inset filling 50-60% of the frame while the circles arc around its upper edge. Bright even high-key light, soft contact shadow under the inset bed, the layout keeps about 15% clean margins from the frame edges. 2K detail-page quality. shots.promptTemplate: {style_lock}. E-commerce pain-point split screen about restless pet sleep. {product_identity_lock}. shots.promptTemplate: {style_lock}. E-commerce material macro for the filling of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. provenance.notes: 源夹名「宠物用品 (23)」，实拍内容为深度睡眠宠物窝（深蓝窝体 + 凉席内垫 + 拆洗内胆），按图判定 L1=宠物用品 / L2=寝具，与夹名一致；库内已有 15 款宠物模版无寝具类，定位不重合。已剥离床身绣字与英文字标、店铺「加入会员全店免费」二维码、原版中文文案（六大好处、EPE珍珠棉、颗粒混纺布/水晶超柔绒等具体材质与数据句改为占位符）。假设：部分切片实拍区为灰色底块，实拍构图按版式与文案语义推断；变体颜色（蓝/粉/红）与 S/L 尺寸改为生成期占位符，需使用者提供真实色号与规格。
